dimensions.label: Public source route-states
dimensions.rationale: Anonymous 1440x900 desktop captures of www.fandango.com under source-current/2026-08-23.fandango-r2/ with paired candidate views under local-current/.

dimensions.label: Source catalog and assets
dimensions.rationale: backend/catalog.py is generated from the public lineup: 16 now-playing and 6 coming-soon titles with real names, ratings, genres, runtimes, synopses and directors, plus 5 real Manhattan theaters with their published addresses and amenity lists. Poster art is vendored per source-assets/manifest.json.

dimensions.label: Offline ticketing tasks
dimensions.rationale: tools/validate_local_ui.py replays all 23 WB047 traces through visible controls; clone/tests covers the same journeys at the API layer.

dimensions.label: Site-isolated stateful tasks
dimensions.rationale: clone/tests exercises booking history mutation and asserts per-actor isolation of favourites and bookings.

dimensions.label: Zero remote runtime requests
dimensions.rationale: A browser pass over the public routes records zero non-local requests and no broken images. Per-journey network traces for the ticketing and account journeys are not recorded yet.
